text:
sara_support: FYI escalation from AcmeCorp — their SSO stopped working after their IdP cert rotation. Customers seeing 403 at our ACS through the ingress. They reported this around 09:10 UTC and can reproduce reliably for some auth flows. Can eng-identity + infra take a look?

devon: On it. Do we have the SAML Response sample or gateway logs? Any recent deploys? :eyes:

sara_support: No deploys on our side. Logs pasted below. Main thing I see is `Signature verification failed` from auth-service and nginx returning 403. Gateway logs show we returned a cached metadata blob with the old cert thumbprint. Customer uses an IdP metadata URL that includes query params and the proxy may be normalizing the URL which could change the cache key.

sara_support: Repro steps they gave:
1) Login -> redirect to IdP with samlRequest
2) IdP posts SAMLResponse to our ACS /saml/acs/tenant/acme
3) Our ACS returns 403 with log: `SAML signature invalid: key not found`

sara_support: Sample of the IdP metadata URL they provided:
```
https://idp.acme.local/metadata?tenant=acme&env=prod
```
They said sometimes the IdP serves a 200 with new certs, sometimes 302 to a CDN url.

raj_p: Is the metadata cached by the auth proxy or by the auth-service? IIRC we cache metadata at both layers (ingress + auth-service) to avoid repeated fetches. If the proxy strips querystring it might be collapsing different URLs under the same cache key.

infra-oncall: Confirmed: our nginx ingress uses normalized cache key (scheme+host+path) and drops querystring for caching static artifacts. We set `proxy_cache_key` to `$scheme$host$uri` in a past perf change. That would cause metadata for `?tenant=acme` vs `?tenant=acme&env=prod` to collide. We also configured `proxy_cache_valid 200 12h;` so stale certs can persist for a while.

devon: Oof. That explains stale cert picked up by nginx. Two fixes: 1) make proxy cache key include `$is_args$args` for the metadata endpoint only; 2) add a metadata refresh endpoint in auth-service and call it on cert rotation events. Can we patch the cache key for `/metadata` at the ingress level first? Low risk.

infra-oncall: I can patch the ingress snippet for the metadata path now. Applying a targeted change to include querystring in cache key for `/metadata` location and set `proxy_cache_valid 200 60s;`. Will roll to prod in a few mins.

sso-bot: metadata-refresh triggered for tenant `acme` via admin API by devops (id: 89234). Response: 202 Accepted.

olivia_idp: From IdP side we returned metadata with two KeyDescriptor elements; order changed when we rotated signing cert. Some SP libraries expect the signing KeyDescriptor first. Our metadata is valid per schema but not all parsers handle KeyDescriptor order.

sara_support: Copy of auth-service log excerpt:
```
ERROR auth-service SAMLVerifier - tenant=acme - signature verification failed: no matching KeyInfo found for signature (expected-thumb: 6f:3b:...)
INFO auth-service SAMLMetadataLoader - tenant=acme - metadata fetched from https://idp.acme.local/metadata?tenant=acme&env=prod (200)
INFO auth-service SAMLMetadataCache - tenant=acme - cache miss, storing new metadata (expires in 36h)
```

devon: Two concurrent problems: (A) proxy normalized cache key dropped query params so sometimes the old metadata blob persisted; (B) IdP changed KeyDescriptor ordering which broke a few parser implementations. Short term: purge the proxy cache and force auth-service to refetch/parse the latest metadata. Medium term: make parser resilient to KeyDescriptor ordering and add canonicalization tests.

infra-oncall: Purged cache for `https://idp.acme.local/metadata` entries and applied the ingress patch. Clearing auth-service metadata cache for tenant `acme` now.

sso-bot: metadata-refresh succeeded for tenant `acme` (200) — parsing ok, active signing thumbprint: 6f:3b:fa:12:...

acme-sys: Confirming from our side — auth flows succeed now. Thanks! We saw the 403 around 09:10 and after the purge it's all green. We still worry about brief auth windows during rotation. Is there a mitigation to make rotation less disruptive?

raj_p: Recommended steps for customers during rotation: 1) publish new cert alongside old in metadata (dual key descriptors) for a grace window; 2) set low Cache-Control on metadata responses during rotation; 3) call our admin metadata-refresh webhook after publish. We should document this in support KB.

devon: Action items: 
- infra: keep the ingress change (include querystring for metadata key) and reduce ttl for metadata responses (PR #4132).
- eng-identity: make SAML parser tolerant to KeyDescriptor ordering + add unit tests (ticket ID IDP-789).
- platform: expose a one-click metadata refresh in Console and an API webhook customers can call post-rotation (ticket PLATFORM-1321).
- support: write KB article with best practices for IdP rotations and step-by-step purge/refresh commands.

sara_support: I'll open the support KB draft and add the customer's repro notes + curl snippets. Quick curl we used to trigger refresh internally:
```
curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/admin/saml/refresh?tenant=acme" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

infra-oncall: Also left a small monitoring alert: SAML signature verification error rate > 0.5% over 5m for any tenant should fire to eng-oncall. Started rolling that out.

acme-sys: Thanks team. Can you confirm how long the patch will be kept? We try rotations nightly for a couple days and want to ensure stability.

devon: We'll keep the ingress change permanently (it fixes a correctness bug). Parser fixes and Console refresh are on the 2-week sprint. I'll ping once IDP-789 lands. :thumbsup:

sara_support: Perfect. Closing the escalation for now, keeping the thread open while tickets progress.

olivia_idp: FYI we will also update our metadata generator to keep signing KeyDescriptor first during rotation for compatibility. Thanks for the heads up. :pray:
